paper.title: Manifold-constrained plasticity enables stable learning in recurrent neural circuits

new_source_clarifications: The article explicitly labels the S8/S11 regime 'Online subspace tracking stabilizes learning under coordinate rotation' and describes S8A as a rotation of manifold coordinates.

The constrained-network prose says the low-dimensional condition uses an explicit projection 'as implemented here', while Eqs.1-4 shown in the article text describe a low-rank W=Q W_k Q^T construction and also claim outside-manifold components decay exponentially. The exact placement of any state projection is therefore code-dependent.
The tracked basis U is explicitly a k-dimensional empirical activity basis, re-orthonormalized every step, and Methods Eqs.35-37 define empirical subspace drift through singular values of U0^T Ut.

The article says Q is initialized as an N x k orthonormal basis and the constrained structural manifold is a fixed linear subspace in the base task; the rotational-drift equation previously audited is a k x k right rotation of Q coordinates.

bounded_identifiability_audit.status: mathematical plus source-derived synthetic audit; not a reproduction of S8/S11/S12

subspace_invariance_result.statement: If Q is N x k orthonormal and R is k x k orthogonal, Q' = Q R has exactly the same k-dimensional ambient span. If empirical activity over a window has full rank k and is strictly confined to span(Q), then any k-dimensional SVD basis of that activity also spans Q; principal angles computed from singular values of U0^T Ut are therefore zero up to numerical error, regardless of rotations of coordinates inside Q.
subspace_invariance_result.implication: A materially nonzero S11-style k-dimensional principal angle under a literal Q <- Q R coordinate rotation requires at least one additional ingredient: off-span activity, effective empirical rank below k / weakly identified covariance directions, a different code-level rotation, a different U rank, incomplete tracking, or a metric implementation that differs from the published principal-angle definition. Within-span basis rotation alone is insufficient.

setup.paired_structural_span: identical Q span before and after coordinate rotation
setup.metric: mean of 3 principal angles between top-3 empirical SVD subspaces

weak_eigenmode_noise_audit.interpretation: The full structural span never moved, yet the k-dimensional empirical principal-angle metric becomes large when secondary covariance modes approach the noise floor or vanish. Thus high mean angle can reflect subspace identifiability / rank degeneracy rather than ambient manifold rotation. This is a candidate explanation to test against the source code and S11 activity spectrum, not a claim that it explains the published figure.

setup.rich_input: three incommensurate sinusoidal drives inside Q at 1.0, 1.7 and 2.3 Hz
setup.comparison: Eq.1-like elementwise tanh dynamics with W=QW_kQ^T, with versus without an explicit post-step projection r <- QQ^T r

nonlinear_projection_sensitivity_audit.interpretation: Low-rank W alone does not make the elementwise nonlinear update exactly subspace-invariant in this source-derived audit, whereas an explicit state projection does. The article prose specifically mentions an explicit projection 'as implemented here', so source-code inspection is now necessary to know which dynamical semantics generated S8/S11. This audit does not infer that the published implementation omitted projection.

candidate_update.new_interpretation: The general mechanism 'track the empirical low-dimensional covariance structure and learn in those coordinates' remains plausible. The rotational-drift evidence is narrower than an ambient-manifold-rotation reading: published coordinate rotation alone preserves span(Q), and the published k-dimensional principal-angle metric can only become materially nonzero if empirical rank/identifiability, off-span dynamics, code semantics, or metric semantics add another source of change. This makes S11 a particularly high-value code-level reproducibility target.
scope: The synthetic audits are not source-exact reproductions and use deliberately transparent controls.

Prior reduced evidence that generic online PCA can match or outperform Oja remains bounded to those reduced controls.
